# OpenAgents Docs

> Understand Omega, the native OpenAgents workspace for projects, agents, code, review, and evidence.

## Omega

- [Omega](https://openagents.com/docs): The native OpenAgents workspace for projects, agents, code, review, and evidence.
- [Availability and setup](https://openagents.com/docs/getting-started): Evaluate Omega without turning prerelease evidence into a support claim.
- [Native workspace](https://openagents.com/docs/workroom): Understand how Omega joins editor truth with agent work and evidence.
- [Full Auto](https://openagents.com/docs/full-auto): Understand the bounded automation direction that Omega is developing.
- [Review and evidence](https://openagents.com/docs/review-and-recovery): Connect Omega work to exact changes, tests, and recovery state.
- [Security and privacy](https://openagents.com/docs/security-and-privacy): The authority, data, credential, and service boundaries for Omega.
- [Troubleshooting](https://openagents.com/docs/troubleshooting): Diagnose an Omega prerelease without widening authority or hiding an open gate.
- [Agent-readable docs](https://openagents.com/docs/agent-readable): Static Omega documentation and discovery artifacts for tools and coding agents.
